lines: YOU SEE, PEOPLE DON'T WANT TO HEAR YOUR OPINION
THEY WANT TO HEAR THEIR OPINION, COMING OUT OF YOUR MOUTH
YOUR FAMILY TREE MUST BE A CACTUS
BECAUSE EVERYONE ON IT IS A PRICK
LOOK. IT IS BARRACK OBAMA AT A SUBARU DEALERSHIP
FRIENDS ARE JUST PEOPLE YOU HATE THE LEAST
WOODY, I WENT INTO ANDY'S MUM'S ROOM.... WE AREN'T THE ONLY TOYS CALLED WOODY AND BUZZ
WE'LL HAVE THOUSANDS OF OLD LADIES RUNNING AROUND WITH TATTOOS
IN THE FUTURE THERE'S ONLY ONE FILM GENRE ITS CALLED 'THE REMAKE'
YOU SEE THAT FLYING AWAY?? THAT WAS MY RESPECT FOR YOU.
IF ALL HUMANS JOINED HANDS AROUND THE GLOBE
A BUNCH OF THEM WOULD DROWN
AND THAT'S HOW BABIES ARE MADE
AND THEY'LL UPVOTE IT TO THE FRONT PAGE

meaning.meaning_en: This meme uses the visual of Woody looking confused and concerned while Buzz excitedly points at something to express the realization that a specific thing or person is everywhere. The first text box usually states the subject, and the second box repeats it with the phrase 'everywhere' to emphasize its overwhelming or annoying prevalence. The humor comes from the contrast between the excitement of discovery and the dawning horror of ubiquity.
meaning.meaning_de: Dieser Meme nutzt das Bild von Woody, der verwirrt und besorgt aussieht, während Buzz begeistert auf etwas zeigt, um den Moment zu beschreiben, in dem man erkennt, dass eine bestimmte Sache oder Person überall ist. Der erste Textbereich nennt das Thema, und der zweite wiederholt es mit dem Zusatz 'überall', um die überwältigende oder nervige Verbreitung zu betonen. Der Humor entsteht durch den Kontrast zwischen der Begeisterung über die Entdeckung und dem wachsenden Schrecken über die Allgegenwart.
situations_en: I just saw that song for the third time today
